description: NEESR Special Structural Walls: Ordinary Boundary Element Tests - Axial Tension/Compression is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by John Wallace, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). Following the February 27, 2010 Mw 8.8 Maule earthquake, an international effort was undertaken to better understand reasons for observed damage to concrete structural walls in buildings located in the affected region of Chile and to address potential design implications. The Chilean building code for concrete structures is based on the U.S. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/DS26X20. Keywords: Structural walls, shear walls, boundary elements, test, cyclic load, ordinary boundary element. Published 2018-09-28. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the DesignSafe listing (publication licences offered are CC BY 4.0, ODC-By, CC0 and GPL; project page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
